When we adopted Max, a Jack Russell Terrier, my husband and I seriously considered giving him up. He was a real mess. In less than a week, he destroyed most of the house: the sofa, the bed, he was doing his business everywhere, and honestly, we had no idea how to handle the situation.
Things reached a point where we were terrified when Max tried to lunge at my daughter. As parents, it was a very difficult time, and we knew we needed professional help before things got worse.
Despite everything, I had grown incredibly attached to him and couldn't bear to let him go. We decided to give it another try and seek professional help. That's when we contacted Dennis, who was very empathetic to our situation from the very beginning and gave us the confidence that things could improve.
Our trainer, Ley, has been simply outstanding. She comes once a week, and we're already on our fifth session. I can't thank her enough for the time, dedication, and patience she has shown, not only with Max but also with us. She has taught us to understand his behavior and to communicate with him in the right way.
Thanks to consistent training and Ley's guidance, the changes in Max's behavior have been truly remarkable. Today, we see a much more balanced dog, and we feel equipped to continue training him.
If there's one thing I've learned in this process, it's that training a dog not only transforms the dog, but also transforms its family. Thank you, Ley, for your professionalism, your patience, and the love you put into your work. You have made an enormous difference in our lives, and we will always be grateful.

Copper loved Daviel and would get so excited to see him but would go into training mode when it was time. Copper learned his commands quickly and was certified as a service dog. Overall a great experience.

Our experience with this group, especially Daviel, was a great one. He is a great trainer leading with expertise, knowledge and patience. Not only did he help train our dog, but also us as owners so that we can continue the process ourselves. Highly recommend this group!

It's clear she does her work with so much love and passion. We are so happy with the progress Beck has made in such a short time and grateful for everything she has taught us.

I happened to stumble across K9 Specialist Inc. at a retail store while I was in the middle of preparing for my new pup's arrival later on that week.

What immediately caught my attention was how exceptionally well-behaved and command-trained Daviel’s student-dog was—especially in the middle of a high-traffic retail environment. It genuinely stopped me in my tracks. I introduced myself on the spot and asked for his contact information, as I knew that level of discipline and control was exactly what I wanted for my pup.

Shortly after, Daviel reached out and took the time to understand my goals for Fiyero (a Cockalier). We scheduled a behavioral assessment, aligned on a tailored training plan, and quickly got started with classes.

We’re now about a month in (four sessions), and I was already impressed by the second class. The progress has been noticeable and consistent. Daviel has a natural ability to connect with dogs, and it clearly shows as Fiyero genuinely looks forward to his weekly sessions.

That said, this is not a “drop-off and done” type of program. There is accountability on the owner’s side, with structured at-home training reinforced between sessions—but that’s precisely what drives results.

Fiyero is well on his way to becoming the kind of well-behaved, disciplined dog that first caught my attention that day in the store. I highly recommend K9 Specialist Inc. to anyone serious about investing in proper training and long-term behavioral development for their dog.

Freddy is an outstanding dog trainer, and I couldn't be happier with the transformation he brought to my pitbull. From our very first session, it was clear that Freddy possesses a unique blend of knowledge, patience, and genuine love for dogs.
Freddy took the time to understand my pitbull personality and specific needs. He tailored the training sessions to suit his temperament, which made a world of difference in his responsiveness.
Using positive reinforcement techniques, Freddy created a fun and engaging atmosphere. My dog thrived on the encouragement, and it made learning new commands feel like a game rather than a chore.
After just a few sessions, I noticed significant changes in my pitbull behavior. He became more obedient, calmer, and even more affectionate. It was incredible to witness the bond between us grow as he learned to trust and respond to commands.
Freddy is an excellent communicator, taking the time to explain each technique and why it works. His guidance has empowered me to continue the training at home, ensuring that the lessons stick.

I wholeheartedly recommend Freddy to anyone looking for a dog trainer. His dedication and expertise have not only transformed my pitbull behavior but have also made me a more confident and knowledgeable dog owner. If you want to see real results and build a lasting bond with your furry friend, Freddy is the trainer you need. I’m so grateful for the positive impact he’s had on our lives!

Working with K‑9 Specialist and our trainer David Pereda was truly the best investment we’ve made for our dog Willie and for ourselves. Willie used to struggle with severe reactivity and anxiety – we couldn’t host anyone at home and every walk was a nightmare.
David’s professionalism, deep knowledge, and skills made all the difference, and the transformation has been incredible. Our dog is now so much calmer and more confident, and his reactivity has dramatically decreased.
Walks and having friends over are genuinely enjoyable for all of us now. We’re so grateful to David for helping us reach a whole new level of connection and communication with Willie!
We highly recommend K-9 Specialist to anybody looking for experienced and supportive trainers.

Working with David Pereda, the trainer of my three dogs, was a truly wonderful and peaceful experience from the very beginning. It's clear he has a lot of experience and, above all, a genuine love for what he does. He didn't rush things or use harsh methods, but rather approached training with patience, first observing each dog's personality, because my three are completely different. I really appreciated that he not only focused on training them, but also on teaching me how to continue reinforcing the positive behavior at home, with clear instructions that were easy to incorporate into our daily routine. In just a few sessions, we already saw noticeable changes in their obedience, attention span, and overall behavior. Seeing how respectfully and consistently he worked gave me a lot of confidence. I truly recommend him to anyone who wants real results and professional yet humane treatment for their dogs. I am so grateful for the work David did with my girls. 🐾💛

Our dog Milo just completed his final lesson with David, and we are absolutely amazed by the results. Before training, Milo was stubborn on walks—constantly pulling and insisting on going his own direction. Worse, he had aggressive reactivity toward other dogs, making walks stressful and challenging. Navigating our building's elevators or city streets often meant waiting forever or turning around to avoid encounters.

Now, we can truly enjoy our walks together! Milo is super obedient, walks beautifully on leash, and ignores other dogs almost completely. What an incredible transformation—it's like we have a whole new dog.

David clearly loves and cares deeply for the dogs he trains. He's always positive, arrives with a smile, and takes the time to explain everything clearly—how the training works for the dog and how we can reinforce it at home each week. His patience and expertise made all the difference.

We're so happy with the progress and excited to continue with the group meetups. If you're dealing with leash pulling, reactivity, or any behavior issues, I can't recommend David and K-9 Specialist enough!"

I highly recommend K-9 Specialist for all dog training needs.
